第46章 爷爷登门-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

这话可正好挠到了赵安坤的痒处，他瞬间来了兴致，得意洋洋地给吴姜介绍起了自己的风水坐馆。

“我的这家坐馆，别看没有门头，看着不起眼，但是在咱们省，那是相当的有牌面！不光是咱们省，就连隔壁省的，都有请我去看风水的。”

吴姜对风水虽然一窍不通，但对赵安坤平时的日常还是很感兴趣的，听得十分认真。

于是，赵安坤便打开了话匣子，详细和他讲了自己平时给客户看风水的一些事情。

最后，还跟吴姜说了，以后他要是有了给客户破煞的业务，要是忙不过来，可以介绍给吴姜去做。

吴姜正愁自己没有人脉，对于赵安坤的好意，自然是连连感谢。

两人一聊，就聊了一下午，直到傍晚时分，吴姜才起身告辞。

赵安坤本来还想请吴姜吃饭，但被吴姜婉拒了，赵安坤只好送他到门口，再次嘱咐他，以后若是遇到难缠的鬼魂或是风水难题，随时可以给他打电话，找他帮忙。

吴姜连连答应，随后驱车离开了古街，朝着爸妈家里的方向驶去。

一路上，他还在琢磨着赵安坤分享的经验，收获颇丰，受益匪浅。

刚回到家，还没来得及进门，就接到了爷爷打电话来说，明天要来绿城的消息，同行的还有苍名县的首富王积友和他儿子王寻。

吴姜在电话里也没多问，心里想着，难道王家的少爷又被什么不干净的东西缠上了？

在老妈这里蹭了一顿饭，和爸妈聊了一会儿家常，吴姜这才回了自己的新家。

刚刚进门，念念就不高兴的从吊坠里飞了出来，双手掐腰，鼓着小脸，看着吴姜冷哼道：“哼，坏哥哥，说话不算数！说好带念念出去玩的，结果根本没让念念出来！”

吴姜顿时有些汗颜，他光顾着和赵安坤聊天，忘了将小丫头放出来了。

他连忙赔着笑脸哄道：“对不起对不起，是哥哥的错，哥哥向你道歉。等周末的时候，哥哥专门带你去游乐场玩，好不好？”

小丫头还是很好哄的，盯着吴姜，脆生生地说道：“这次一定要说话算话啊！不然念念就要真的生气了！”

吴姜连忙点头保证，小丫头这才笑嘻嘻的扑进了他的怀里。

These words just scratched Zhao Ankun's itch. He suddenly became interested and proudly introduced his Feng Shui sitting room to Wu Jiang.

"This restaurant of mine may not look very impressive, but in our province, it is quite famous! People not only from our province, but also from the province next door have invited me to see Feng Shui."

Although Wu Jiang knew nothing about Feng Shui, he was still very interested in Zhao Ankun's daily life and listened very carefully.

So, Zhao Ankun started chatting and told him in detail some of the things he usually does to show Feng Shui to clients.

Finally, he told Wu Jiang that if he had the business of breaking evil spirits for clients in the future, and if he was too busy, he could introduce Wu Jiang to do it.

Wu Jiangzheng was worried that he had no connections, so he naturally thanked Zhao Ankun profusely for his kindness.

The two chatted all afternoon, and it was not until evening that Wu Jiang got up to say goodbye.

Zhao Ankun originally wanted to invite Wu Jiang to dinner, but Wu Jiang declined. Zhao Ankun had to send him to the door and told him again that if he encountered difficult ghosts or Feng Shui problems in the future, he could call him at any time and ask for his help.

Wu Jiang agreed repeatedly, and then drove out of the ancient street and headed towards his parents' home.

Along the way, he was still thinking about the experience shared by Zhao Ankun, and he gained a lot and benefited a lot.

As soon as I got home, before I could even get in, I received a call from my grandfather saying that he was coming to Greentown tomorrow, along with Wang Jiyou, the richest man in Cangming County, and his son Wang Xun.

Wu Jiang didn't ask any questions on the phone. He was thinking, could it be that the young master of the Wang family was entangled with something unclean again?

After having a meal at her mother's place and chatting with her parents for a while, Wu Jiang returned to his new home.

Just after entering the door, Nian Nian flew out of the pendant in displeasure, pinched her waist with both hands, puffed up her face, looked at Wu Jiang and snorted coldly: "Huh, bad brother, you don't keep your words! I promised to take Nian Nian out to play, but in the end I didn't let Nian Nian come out at all!"

Wu Jiang suddenly felt ashamed. He was so busy chatting with Zhao Ankun that he forgot to let the little girl out.

He quickly coaxed with a smile on his face: "I'm sorry, sorry, it's my brother's fault. I apologize to you. When the weekend comes, I will take you to the amusement park to play, okay?"

The little girl was still very coaxable. She stared at Wu Jiang and said crisply: "You must keep your word this time! Otherwise Nian Nian will be really angry!"

Wu Jiang quickly nodded in assurance, and then the little girl threw herself into his arms with a smile.
